service.description: What a tenant can send: its audits, saved runs and connections, for the transfer's pick and map steps.

parameter.name: tenantUserGroupId
parameter.description: The source tenant.

parameter.name: audits
parameter.description: [{auditId, auditCode, auditName, statementCount, checkCount}] sorted by auditCode.

parameter.name: runs
parameter.description: [{savedRunId, ruleSetName, auditCodes}]: the tenant's saved runs and the audits whose checks use each.

parameter.name: connections
parameter.description: [{ref, kind, id, description, granted}]: owned connections and those shared to the tenant (granted: true).

service.description: The bundle a target imports: the picked audits with every statement, check, run, query, conclusion code and connection they reach, plus picked runs and connections. Ids travel as refs; secrets never travel.

parameter.name: tenantUserGroupId
parameter.description: The source tenant.

parameter.name: auditCodes
parameter.description: Audits to send, by auditCode.

parameter.name: savedRunIds
parameter.description: Saved runs to send on their own, by savedRunId.

parameter.name: connectionRefs
parameter.description: Connections to send that no picked audit or run reaches, as KIND:id refs from the catalog.

parameter.name: sourceInstanceLabel
parameter.description: This instance's name as the operator knows it, e.g. local.

parameter.name: secretsPublicKey
parameter.description: DAR-ADMIN-007. The target's publicKey from begin#SecretHandoff (base64 SPKI). When given, each owned connection's non-empty credentials are sealed to it (sealedSecrets), the bundle carries secrets {wrappedKey, keyFingerprint, alg}, and one AdminAuditLog row records what was sealed to which key. Without it no credential is read.

parameter.name: bundle
parameter.description: {bundleVersion, source, connections, queries, conclusionCodes, runs, audits, statements, checks}; consumed unchanged by import#ConfigBundle.

set.from: darpan.admin.transfer.ConfigTransferExporter.bundle(ec, tenantUserGroupId, auditCodes, savedRunIds, connectionRefs, sourceInstanceLabel, secretsPublicKey)

service.description: Plans a bundle into a target tenant (apply false: a dry run that writes nothing) or applies the plan previewed (apply true with its planHash), in one transaction: all of it or none of it.

parameter.name: tenantUserGroupId
parameter.description: The target tenant.

parameter.name: bundle
parameter.description: The bundle export#ConfigBundle answered, unchanged.

parameter.name: connectionMap
parameter.description: {connection ref: an existing target connection id, or CREATE}, one entry per bundle connection.

parameter.name: apply
parameter.description: True writes; false only plans.

parameter.name: planHash
parameter.description: Required with apply: the planHash of the preview being applied.

parameter.name: secretHandoffToken
parameter.description: DAR-ADMIN-007. The handoffToken begin#SecretHandoff answered on this instance for this tenant; required when the bundle carries sealed credentials.

parameter.name: plan
parameter.description: {lines: [{kind, ref, label, action (CREATE | UPDATE | UNCHANGED | MAPPED | NEEDS_CREDENTIALS), targetId, changes: [{field, from, to}], and on connection lines of a bundle with sealed credentials secretsFilled and secretsKept (field names)}], blocking: [{code, ref, message}], warnings: [{code, ref, message}], counts: {action: n, CREDENTIALS_FILLED: connections}}.

parameter.name: planHash
parameter.description: SHA-256 of the bundle, connection map, target tenant and plan.

parameter.name: idMap
parameter.description: When applied: every bundle ref to its target id.

parameter.name: applied
parameter.description: True when the plan was written.

set.from: darpan.admin.transfer.ConfigTransferImporter.apply(ec, tenantUserGroupId, bundle, connectionMap, planHash, bundle?.source?.instanceLabel, secretHandoffToken)

service.description: DAR-ADMIN-007. Starts a credentials handoff on the TARGET: a one-time RSA-3072 key pair. The source seals credentials to publicKey; handoffToken carries the private key sealed with this instance's own entity encryption, for this tenant, for 30 minutes. Nothing is stored.

parameter.name: tenantUserGroupId
parameter.description: The target tenant.

parameter.name: publicKey
parameter.description: Base64 SPKI, for export#ConfigBundle secretsPublicKey.

parameter.name: handoffToken
parameter.description: Opaque; only this instance can open it. For import#ConfigBundle secretHandoffToken.

parameter.name: keyFingerprint
parameter.description: Hex SHA-256 of the SPKI bytes.

parameter.name: expiresAt
parameter.description: When the token stops opening.
